ideas.workingTitle: One Song, No Audience — future Shivani–Deepu kiss setup
ideas.priority: Saved for later; explicitly NOT the current Episode 04A Scene 02
ideas.premise: At a future society programme soundcheck, Deepu is testing an upbeat track when Shivani arrives to check display placement. He stops it, she jokes 'Mere aate hi music bandh?', he surprises her with 'Aap dance karengi toh phir chala deta hoon', and she says 'Chalao.' She initiates a spontaneous short dance; they discover a different, mutual chemistry beyond event coordination. After the song, he says 'Ma'am... gaana khatam ho gaya' and she replies 'Pata hai.' A brief mutually initiated kiss MAY be considered only much later, when the author decides the narrative has reached an appropriate kiss beat. If Kavya arrives afterward, she has not witnessed any private moment; the meaning of her arrival must be separately reviewed.
